intent: Record as reviewed the shape, confirmation, stop, scoping, simulated-user and comparison rules the batch Context enforces and tests.
observable_outcome: get-context batch lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A batch is refused before anything is saved unless it has 1 to 10 trials and 1 to 50 test cases with no test case repeated.
A batch is refused as a whole, naming every unconfirmed test case, when any of its test cases lacks confirmed run permissions.
When starting a batch's next trial finds its target gone, the batch stops with reason target_gone and starts no further trial.

A batch answers a trial's questions as the simulated person only when the trial's conversation ended successfully, its test case has facts and the creator still exists; otherwise the questions are left for a real person.
A batch is marked settled only once none of its trials is still running or owed an answer.
Two batches are compared only on test cases judged in both; a test case judged in only one counts as unpaired, not as better, worse or tied.
When a batch's creator no longer exists, the batch stops as creator_gone instead of starting another trial with no actor.
